parameters.query:
SELECT control_id, control_name, framework, owner_email,
       EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW()-last_evidence_date)::INT as days_stale
FROM audit_controls
WHERE active=true AND (last_evidence_date IS NULL OR last_evidence_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
ORDER BY framework, control_id;

INSERT INTO audit_evidence_requests (request_id,owner_email,control_count,due_date,sent_at)
VALUES ('REQ-NOW','placeholder@co',0,'2024-01-01',NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

meta.description: Runs 1st of each month. Queries controls with stale evidence >90 days. Groups by owner, sends evidence requests with 14-day deadline.
